answer: One bench, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk. A farm falls at the first real check when the check is Master ink maker bottling file with trade council attestation, which demands 6-year apprenticeship, 288 supervised ink batches, journeyman exam, guild dues from every applicant. Without the bench there is no jade, without the purse there is no grove, and without the years there is no anchor: the farm owns none of the three. The proof is not transferable: 516 aliases need 516 proofs, 56244 POA, and 8256 minutes of somebody's real time.
